name: Funded Startup Lead Generation & Outreach Engine
description: Scrapes newly funded tech startups from Inc42, resolves verified CTO/CEO contacts via Apollo, synthesizes peer-to-peer engineering pitches with Gemini Flash, and stages records into Airtable for 1-click human review.

values.instruction:
Extract the funded startups mentioned on this page as a JSON array of objects. For each startup, extract:
- companyName (string): name of the startup
- websiteUrl (string): clean website URL or domain (e.g. 'zepto.co.in' or 'https://zepto.co.in')
- fundingRound (string): round type (e.g. 'Seed', 'Pre-Series A', 'Series A', 'Series B', 'Growth')
- fundingAmount (string): amount raised (e.g. '$665M' or 'INR 50 Cr')
- leadInvestors (string): key lead venture investors
- productSummary (string): 1-2 sentence description of what product or technology they build.
